title: IRS Nonprofits & Foundations by State
description: Every tax-exempt organization the IRS lists for a state (Exempt Organizations Business Master File): EIN, name, address, 501(c) subsection, foundation type, NTEE category, ruling year, assets, income and revenue. Filter by name, city, NTEE, revenue or private foundations.
why: The IRS master list, read fresh from irs.gov each run. Tick 'private foundations only' and sort by revenue to get a state's grantmakers.
useCases: Grant writers and nonprofits finding funders (private foundations) near them
Vendors selling to nonprofits by size and cause (NTEE)
Researchers sizing a state's nonprofit sector

city.title: City
city.description: Exact city in capitals, e.g. MINNEAPOLIS

minRevenue.title: Minimum revenue (USD)
minRevenue.description: From the latest return the IRS processed.

limits: Sorted by revenue, largest first. Financials are from the organization's latest return in the IRS file.
